ios.desc:
Weather-Proof Your Commute: Master Toronto's Underground PATH

Toronto has one of the largest networks of pedestrian tunnels (AKA the PATH). The Toronto Path App helps you get to your destination optimizing to keep you inside as much as possible. With 170+ mapped doors, and detailed 3d maps you'll never get lost again!

Features:

- Interactive Maps: Experience detailed and interactive 2D and 3D maps.
- Mapped Doors: Easily find any of the 170+ doors to the Path, each with detailed pictures and precise location.
- Precise Navigation: Get detailed navigation guidance to your destination, whether you're walking outside or inside the PATH.
- Multiple Routes: Choose the best route that best suits your needs, optimize for speed or for staying inside, up to you!
- Unified Experience: Effortlessly switch between map views for indoor and outdoor locations with smooth transitions.

Download now and explore Toronto like never before!
